source.paraphrase: Flatten dependent streams with switchMap or mergeMap instead of subscribing inside a subscribe callback.

invariants.why: A nested subscribe hides the inner subscription: it is never piped, never cancelled with the outer one, and leaks on every emission.
invariants.fixHint: Pipe the outer stream: users$.pipe(switchMap((u) => ordersFor(u))).subscribe(show).
invariants.avoid: Extracting the inner subscribe into a helper called from the callback is still a subscribe inside a subscribe.

source.paraphrase: toPromise is deprecated and removed. Convert a finite stream with firstValueFrom or lastValueFrom.

invariants.why: toPromise no longer exists on current RxJS. Code that calls it fails against the installed version.
invariants.fixHint: Return firstValueFrom(orders$) for one emission, or lastValueFrom(orders$) for completion.
invariants.avoid: Awaiting the call does not modernize it. await obs.toPromise() is still the deprecated conversion.

source.paraphrase: A computed derives its value from the signals it reads. It never writes a signal with set or update.

invariants.why: Writing inside computed creates a feedback loop: the write invalidates the computation that just ran, and the graph can cycle.
invariants.fixHint: Return the derived value only. Use linkedSignal(() => ...) for writable state derived from signals, or move the write into an event handler or the code that owns the source signal.
invariants.avoid: update is a write like set. Rewriting the same value through update is still a write inside computed.

source.paraphrase: Every HttpClient call names its response type, so the untyped reference never flows into components as any.

invariants.why: An untyped get returns any. Every field access on the response compiles, and a renamed backend field surfaces at runtime.
invariants.fixHint: Add the type argument: this.http.get<User[]>(url). Name the domain type next to the service that fetches it.
invariants.avoid: Typing only the get while leaving post, put, patch, or delete bare keeps an untyped reference on the same service.
